main_text.l: mini de cœlis, & dixit, Abraham, Abra-
12. Et dixit, ne extendas manum tuam
ad puerum, & ne facias ei quicquam, quia
nunc cognoui quòd tu times Deum, &
& vidit, & ecce aries post se, detentus in
perplexitate spinarum, in cornibus suis. Et
dere fecit eum in holocaustum pro filio
tur hodie, In monte Dominus videbitur.
16. Et dixit, Per me iuraui, dixit Domi-
nus, quia pro eo quòd fecisti rem hanc, &
non prohibuisti filium tuum, vnicum tuum.

page.notes: Printed text is set in a fairly large, slightly blurred type; some letters in the first lines are doubtful, notably "Abraham" in line one and "post se" (read as "post se"), and the marginal ink marks at left and right are not transcribed. The last word "tuum" is printed at the right margin, and the faint "tuum" mark below it may be a catchword-like signature mark and is left out.
